name: VARPA
description: VARPA calculates the population variance (n denominator) while treating text as 0 and logical values TRUE as 1 and FALSE as 0.
tldr: Population variance that also counts text and logicals as numbers.

parameters.name: value1
parameters.description: The first value, range, or reference in the population.

basicExample.description: Population variance of numeric values only
basicExample.explanation: With only numbers present, VARPA returns the same result as VARP.

advancedExamples.title: Text and TRUE are counted
advancedExamples.scenario: A range that mixes numbers, text, and a logical
advancedExamples.description: Text becomes 0 and TRUE becomes 1 before the calculation
advancedExamples.explanation: The values used are 10,20,30,1,0; the mean is 12.2 and the population variance (sum of squared deviations 656.8 divided by 5) is 131.36.

advancedExamples.title: Contrast with VARP on a reference
advancedExamples.description: VARP ignores text and logicals inside a range
advancedExamples.explanation: VARP sees only 10,20,30 (n=3), variance 100, whereas VARPA counts all five values for 131.36.

howItWorks: VARPA coerces every argument to a number (text to 0, TRUE to 1, FALSE to 0), then computes the population variance using the n denominator. Because it divides by n rather than n-1, it assumes the supplied values constitute the whole population.

howToSteps.name: Identify values
howToSteps.text: Collect the values, including any text or logicals you want counted.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The population variance including non-numerics is shown.

limitations: Counting text as 0 can distort the result if text cells are labels rather than true zeros.
Dividing by n assumes a full population; for a sample use VARA.
Requires at least one effective value, otherwise returns #DIV/0!.

commonErrors.cause: No effective numeric values after coercion.
commonErrors.fix: Provide at least one value that evaluates to a number.

commonErrors.cause: Text labels were coerced to 0, pulling the mean down.
commonErrors.fix: Use VARP when text cells should be ignored.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: VARPA is available in Google Sheets with the same coercion rules.

faq.question: Does VARPA treat empty cells as 0?
faq.answer: No. Empty cells are ignored; only text and logicals are coerced (text to 0, TRUE to 1, FALSE to 0).

faq.question: When should I use VARPA instead of VARP?
faq.answer: When your data includes logicals or text that genuinely represent 1/0 or zero, and you want them in the population.

faq.question: What is the sample equivalent?
faq.answer: VARA, which uses the n-1 denominator instead of n.
